case.title: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
case.briefing: You negotiate for Hollerau Pumpenwerke with Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH. Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor. Need: 30000 kits a year. Category goal: routine: fewer suppliers and less process cost. Score: the lowest total cost C as defined in the rules, valued with this case's rates (need lead time 5 days). message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear Mr Stadler,

You wrote that you want to keep supporting our operations with reliable delivery. Our options do that in a concrete way: the whole fastener kit under one agreement with you, with a binding volume that gives your plant one steady, planned load.

Option A is the package we can approve. It gives you the longest contract and a binding annual volume, and the claims below show why the price belongs where it is.

On the cost side:
Our forecast for Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc rises 6.0% (fc:360010@2026-09).

On our past orders of the bolt:
Our orders of Hex bolt ISO 4017 M12x40 8.8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2025-05-26 (po:4500012506-10), EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-01-26 (po:4500013479-10) and EUR 12.46 per 100 units on 2026-09-30 (po:4500014475-10): the price has been unchanged.

On our past orders of the nut:
Our orders of Hex nut ISO 4032 M12 8, zinc with you were placed at EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2024-09-30 (po:4500011486-20), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2025-06-02 (po:4500012538-10), EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-01-30 (po:4500013504-10) and EUR 4.91 per 100 units on 2026-09-28 (po:4500014466-10): the price has been unchanged.

We can offer you the following options:
Option A: unit price EUR 5.18; payment 90 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option B: unit price EUR 5.13; payment 45 days net; contract term 36 months.
Option C: unit price EUR 5.15; payment 60 days net; contract term 36 months.
Binding volume in every option: 30,000 units a year over 36 months.

Option A is the one we would like to see.

If you confirm Option A as it stands, we can confirm the order straight away. Since a decision of this kind may need sign-off on your side, please take Option A to the person who decides.

What would you need from us to confirm Option A?

Best regards
Purchasing
Hollerau Pumpenwerke GmbH

message.from_name: Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
message.subject: Re: Quote from Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH: Bundle the fastener kit with one distributor
message.body:
Dear customer,

We have reviewed your offer and can adjust our Angebot as follows. We received a lot of material; we looked at what bears on this part. We checked the price history data you cited; it holds, but it does not change our calculation. We checked the volume change data you cited; it holds and we took it into account. 

We welcome the proposed 36-month contract and the binding volume of 30,000 units per year. Our offer provides a price of €5.56 per unit, Zahlungsziel 60 days net, a contract term of 36 months. As an alternative, to confirm your preferred Option A with 90-day payment terms, we require a unit price of EUR 5.59 with a price of €5.59 per unit, Zahlungsziel 90 days net, a contract term of 36 months. We have factored in the historical data you provided to reach this price, and we remain open to shorter payment terms if you seek a lower rate.

Our price follows our main cost drivers: PPI-C2594, LCI-C. Our standard Zahlungsziel is 30 days net. Our general terms and conditions apply; the quote lists our standard terms. A binding higher volume would help us and can improve the price. Which volume can you commit to? This offer stays valid for 30 days.

Mit freundlichen Grüßen
Franz Stadler
Inside Sales, Schraubenhandel Leitner & Sohn GmbH
